title: Working Student - Operations Support
duties: Inventory verification
Conduct cycle counts and compare physical stock with WMS records to identify and report discrepancies.
Replenishment
Restock assigned shelf locations through WMS-guided workflows and respond to product-availability needs.
Picking and fulfilment
Use barcode scanners and WMS instructions to support accurate picking and daily operational targets.
Quality checks
Inspect products for damage, packaging condition, expiry dates and quality standards.
Product classification
Separate below-standard products and record quantities classified for disposal or Too Good To Go resale.
Shift reporting
Report quality findings, product quantities, classifications and operational issues to team leads through Slack during assigned quality shifts.
Exception handling
Investigate stock and replenishment discrepancies, communicate findings and escalate issues through established workflows.
Workflow observations
Identified recurring barcode-scanning delays, plastic-packaging damage and tote-position linking problems, and raised practical improvement suggestions.
Layout improvement
Identified lane congestion linked to product placement and proposed a revised layout that was subsequently adopted for a workflow involving approximately 15-20 people.
Team coordination
Coordinate with colleagues and shift leadership in an international fulfilment team, following operating standards and time-sensitive priorities.

title: Operations Team Lead
duties: Team leadership
Coordinated daily activities for 6-8 employees and communicated operational priorities through Microsoft Teams.
Sales and KPI tracking
Monitored sales figures and team KPIs in Excel using sorting and lookup functions.
Demand monitoring
Reviewed changes in sales and demand timing to inform stock and operational priorities.
Stock replenishment
Monitored stock needs for new designs and coordinated replenishment requests through Microsoft Teams.
Customer service and returns
Reviewed return reasons, investigated recurring customer issues and coordinated resolutions.
Daily reporting
Reported sales and operational progress to the supervisor, including customer and stock-related issues.
Promotional materials
Created promotional banners using Microsoft PowerPoint to support product communication.
Security coordination
Supported CCTV monitoring and security coordination as part of daily shop operations.

title: General Banking Intern
duties: Account applications
Processed up to 15 new-account applications in one day and prepared documentation for final review.
Account and product support
Supported savings, current, term-deposit/FDR and DPS account-related processes and explained product requirements to customers.
KYC documentation
Checked customer photographs, birth certificates or national identity documents, addresses, income-source information and supporting paperwork.
AML procedures
Completed required AML screening steps for new customers according to branch procedures.
Customer records
Updated customer and account information in the Core Banking System and maintained supporting records.
Document processing
Organised and scanned completed application files and sent them to LOD for central processing and final checks using Docs Dex; used SharePoint for file storage and sharing.
Cheque and card tracking
Maintained cheque-book and debit/credit-card distribution trackers in Excel using sorting and lookup functions.
Funds clearance
Checked funds-clearance status through TCS as part of routine branch processing.
Account services
Supported dormant-account activation and customer-requested account closures.
Customer communication
Answered product and account inquiries, explained required documents and followed up on missing information.
Cash-transaction support
Assisted routine cash-transaction processes under staff supervision.
Credit-department support
Assisted information requests from the credit department and participated in mortgage-asset site visits.
Reports and meetings
Prepared Word and Excel reports and shared progress in morning and end-of-day meetings with the manager.
Student-account campaign
Supported a college student-account campaign through customer communication and product information.
Branch notices
Prepared PowerPoint notices for branch information boards.
